speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)

The clinical picture of fever, altered mental status, and severe muscle rigidity (indicated by the markedly elevated Creatine Kinase of 5600 U/L) in a patient taking haloperidol is classic for NMS. The normal CSF analysis rules out meningitis or encephalitis, and the symptoms do not fit a migraine diagnosis.
